q: Do you work or are you a student?
ph: At the moment, I'm a full-time student at...
I'm in my final year, so my schedule is quite packed.
h: Faqat «I'm a student» deb to'xtamang: nima o'qishingiz va nega yoqishini qo'shing.

q: What do you like most about your hometown?
ph: What I love most is the sense of community.
It's a small but lively place.
h: Bitta aniq narsani tanlab, uni misol bilan tushuntiring.

q: Do you prefer living in a house or an apartment? Why?
ph: I'd definitely go for a house, mainly because...
Apartments are more convenient, but...
h: Taqqoslash iboralari: «whereas», «on the other hand».

q: How do you usually spend your weekends?
ph: I tend to spend my weekends catching up with friends.
If the weather's nice, I usually go hiking.
h: Odatni bildirish uchun: tend to, usually, more often than not.

q: Do you enjoy reading? What kind of books do you like?
ph: I'm a big fan of science fiction.
I read mostly on my phone these days.
h: Kitob nomini sanash shart emas, nega yoqishini ayting.

q: What kind of music do you listen to?
ph: I'm into all sorts of music, but mostly pop.
It really depends on my mood.
h: «It depends» desangiz, darhol ikki vaziyatdan misol keltiring.

q: Do you like cooking?
ph: I'm not much of a cook, to be honest.
My signature dish is plov.
h: Halol javob bering: «not really» ham yaxshi javob, faqat sababini qo'shing.

q: What's your favorite season? Why?
ph: Autumn is my favorite, hands down.
I love the crisp air and the colors.
h: Sifatlarni boyiting: crisp, mild, scorching, chilly.

q: How often do you use social media?
ph: Probably more often than I should.
I check Instagram a few times a day.
h: Chastota iboralari: every so often, from time to time, on a daily basis.

q: Do you prefer to study in the morning or at night?
ph: I'm definitely more of a morning person.
My concentration peaks early in the day.
h: «more of a ... person» iborasi Speaking'da juda tabiiy eshitiladi.

q: Do you like walking? Where do you usually walk?
ph: I try to walk for at least half an hour a day.
There's a lovely park near my place.
h: Joyni tasvirlang: u yerda nima ko'rinadi, o'zingizni qanday his qilasiz.

q: What do you usually have for breakfast?
ph: I usually grab something quick, like tea and bread.
On weekends we have a proper family breakfast.
h: Ish kunlari va dam olish kunlarini taqqoslab, javobni kengaytiring.

q: Do you like going to the cinema?
ph: I prefer watching films at home these days.
Nothing beats the big screen for action films.
h: Kino so'zlari: plot, special effects, gripping, overrated.

q: Have you ever learned to play a musical instrument?
ph: I took piano lessons as a kid, but I gave up.
I've always wanted to learn the guitar.
h: O'tgan tajribani Past Simple bilan aytib, hozirgi holatni qo'shing.

q: Do you prefer phone calls or text messages?
ph: I'd rather text, since it's less intrusive.
For important things, I always call.
h: «I'd rather...» va «I prefer... to...» qoliplaridan foydalaning.

q: What do you do to relax?
ph: Nothing helps me unwind like a long walk.
I usually switch off my phone and read.
h: Foydali so'zlar: unwind, recharge, switch off, take my mind off things.

q: Do you like shopping?
ph: I'm not a big shopper, honestly.
I'd rather shop online to save time.
h: Do'konga borib va onlayn xarid qilishni taqqoslang.

q: What kind of weather do you like?
ph: I can't stand extreme heat.
Mild, sunny days are perfect for me.
h: Yoqmagan narsani ham aytish mumkin: I can't stand..., I'm not keen on...

q: Do you think handwriting is still important?
ph: I think it still matters, especially in exams.
Most of my writing is typed these days.
h: Fikr + sabab: «I believe so, mainly because...»

q: Do you like taking photos?
ph: I take loads of photos on my phone.
Mostly of food and landscapes, to be honest.
h: Nimani suratga olishingiz va ularni qayerda saqlashingizni qo'shing.

q: Do you prefer to travel alone or with others?
ph: I'd always choose to travel with friends.
Traveling solo gives you more freedom, though.
h: Ikkala tomonni qisqa tilga oling, keyin o'z tanlovingizni ayting.

q: What's your favorite kind of food?
ph: I'm a huge fan of Uzbek cuisine, especially manti.
I could eat it every day.
h: Ta'mni tasvirlovchi sifatlar: savory, spicy, mouth-watering.

q: Do you spend much time outdoors?
ph: Not as much as I'd like to.
I try to get some fresh air every evening.
h: «Not as much as I'd like to» tabiiy va halol javob.

q: Did you enjoy school as a child?
ph: I loved primary school, mostly because of my teacher.
Secondary school was more stressful.
h: O'tmishdagi odat uchun: used to + fe'l. Masalan: I used to love...

q: Who was your favorite teacher at school?
ph: The teacher who influenced me most was my English teacher.
She always pushed us to think for ourselves.
h: Bitta aniq voqea javobingizni esda qolarli qiladi.

q: Do you like animals? Do you have a pet?
ph: I've always been an animal lover.
We have a cat who rules the house.
h: Hazil aralash javob fluency'ni ko'rsatadi, lekin qisqa bo'lsin.

q: How do you usually get to school or work?
ph: I usually take the metro, which takes about twenty minutes.
It's quick and reasonably cheap.
h: Transport so'zlari: commute, rush hour, crowded, convenient.

q: Do you prefer sunrise or sunset?
ph: I'd go for sunset, without a doubt.
It's the perfect end to the day.
h: Qisqa savolga ham 2–3 gap bilan javob bering.

q: Do you like visiting museums?
ph: I find history museums fascinating.
Art galleries aren't really my cup of tea.
h: «not my cup of tea» yoqmasligini muloyim aytish usuli.

q: What do you usually do on your birthday?
ph: Nothing too fancy, just dinner with my family.
My friends usually surprise me with a cake.
h: Odat uchun usually yoki tend to. O'tgan yilgi tug'ilgan kunni Past Simple bilan misol qiling.

q: Do you like getting up early?
ph: I'm not a fan of early mornings.
But once I'm up, I'm quite productive.
h: «but» bilan javobni burib, ikkinchi tomonni ko'rsating.

q: How important is sport in your life?
ph: Sport plays a big part in my routine.
I play football with friends twice a week.
h: Raqam va chastota aniq bo'lsin: twice a week, every morning.

q: Do you like rainy days?
ph: I actually love rainy days.
They're perfect for staying in with a book.
h: Kutilmagan javob (I actually love...) qiziq eshitiladi.

q: Do you often use public transport?
ph: Yes, almost every day.
It's much cheaper than taking a taxi.
h: Afzallik va kamchilikni qisqa qo'shing.

q: Do you prefer reading books or watching films?
ph: Books, because they leave room for imagination.
Films are better when I'm tired.
h: Taqqoslash qolipi: «...is far more ... than ...»

q: What did you want to be when you were a child?
ph: When I was little, I wanted to be a pilot.
My dream changed as I grew older.
h: O'tmishdagi orzu: I wanted to be..., I dreamed of becoming...

q: Do you like to plan things in advance?
ph: I'm quite an organized person, so yes.
I plan my week every Sunday evening.
h: Odatingizni aniq misol bilan tasdiqlang.

q: Do you enjoy spending time alone?
ph: I need some time alone to recharge.
Too much of it makes me feel lonely, though.
h: Muvozanatli javob: ijobiy va salbiy tomon.

q: What kind of TV programs do you watch?
ph: I mostly watch documentaries.
I hardly ever watch TV these days; I stream everything.
h: So'zlar: documentary, series, binge-watch, streaming.

q: Do you like art?
ph: I appreciate art, but I can't draw at all.
I like modern art more than classical paintings.
h: Kamtarona hazil: «I can't draw to save my life».

q: How do you keep in touch with your friends?
ph: Mostly through Telegram.
We try to meet up at least once a month.
h: keep in touch, catch up, meet up, drift apart.

q: Do you like your name?
ph: Yes, I do. It means 'light' in Uzbek.
My grandfather chose it for me.
h: Ismning ma'nosi yoki uni kim qo'ygani javobni boyitadi.

q: What's your favorite color?
ph: I'd say blue, as it's calming.
Most of my clothes are dark colors.
h: Oddiy savolga ham sabab qo'shing.

q: Do you like flowers?
ph: I like them, but I don't know many names.
My mother grows roses in our garden.
h: Javobni oilangiz yoki uyingiz bilan bog'lasangiz, tabiiy chiqadi.

q: Do you think it's important to be on time?
ph: Absolutely, being punctual shows respect.
It drives me crazy when people are late.
h: Fikr + his: «It drives me crazy when...»

q: How often do you go to the park?
ph: Every weekend, if the weather's good.
It's my favorite place to clear my head.
h: clear my head, get some fresh air, stretch my legs.

q: Do you like singing?
ph: Only in the shower!
I'm a terrible singer, but I enjoy it.
h: Qisqa hazil + sabab tabiiy javob beradi.

q: Do you prefer big parties or small gatherings?
ph: I'd choose a small gathering any day.
You can actually talk to people properly.
h: «any day» qat'iy afzallikni bildiradi.

q: What do you usually do in the evenings?
ph: After dinner, I usually review my notes.
Then I scroll through my phone for a bit.
h: Ketma-ketlik so'zlari: after that, then, before bed.

q: Do you like to try new foods?
ph: I'm quite adventurous with food.
Last month I tried sushi for the first time.
h: So'nggi tajribangizdan misol qo'shing: Last month I...

q: Is there anything you would like to learn in the future?
ph: I'd love to learn how to code.
It would open up a lot of opportunities.
h: Kelajak orzusi: I'd love to..., I'm hoping to...

q: Do you prefer the beach or the mountains?
ph: I'm more of a mountain person.
There's nothing like the fresh air in the mountains.
h: O'zbekistondagi aniq joyni tilga oling: Chimyon, Zomin.

q: Do you use a computer a lot?
ph: I use my laptop for almost everything.
Mostly for studying and watching videos.
h: Nimaga ishlatishingizni sanab bering.

q: Do you often visit your relatives?
ph: We visit my grandparents every Friday.
Family is really important in my culture.
h: Madaniyat haqida qisqa izoh javobga chuqurlik beradi.

q: What's the best age to start learning a foreign language?
ph: I'd say the earlier, the better.
Children pick up languages much faster.
h: Qolip: the + qiyosiy daraja, the + qiyosiy daraja. Masalan: the earlier, the better.

q: Do you like the place where you live now?
ph: Overall, yes, although it's a bit noisy.
It's close to everything I need.
h: «Overall, yes, although...» muvozanatli javob qolipi.

q: Do you like reading the news?
ph: I skim the headlines every morning.
I prefer news apps to TV news.
h: skim, headlines, reliable sources, fake news.

q: Do you think you are a patient person?
ph: I'd like to think so, but traffic tests my patience.
I'm patient with people, but not with slow internet.
h: O'zingiz haqida halol va hazil aralash fikr qiziq eshitiladi.

q: How often do you look in the mirror?
ph: I don't spend much time in front of the mirror.
Just a quick check before I leave home.
h: G'alati savolga ham shoshilmay, tabiiy javob bering: «That's an interesting question...»

q: Do you prefer to work in a team or alone?
ph: It depends on the task, really.
For creative work, I prefer a team.
h: «It depends» desangiz, darhol ikkita misol keltiring.
